prompt_used: You are given an image. Write a detailed natural language prompt that could have been used to generate this image. Focus on the most salient and unique visual elements such as the subjects, their clothing, expressions, actions, background, and composition. Describe the color palette, lighting, and overall style, including any cinematic or artistic qualities like camera angle, depth of field, or motion. Make the description as accurate and faithful to the image as possible. If small details are uncertain or ambiguous, omit them and prioritize capturing the overall scene, mood, and visual impression. The final prompt should be coherent, evocative, written as if by an expert visual artist or filmmaker recreating the exact scene.
caption: A close-up, cinematic shot of a person holding a festive McFlurry cup in both hands, set against a softly blurred background of warm, glowing holiday lights. The subject’s hands are delicately positioned, one hand steadying the cup while the other stirs with a white plastic spoon. The cup is decorated in vibrant green with cheerful holiday motifs—red and white illustrations of gifts, trees, and a church, along with the text “Holiday McFlurry” in gold and Japanese characters beneath. The person is dressed warmly in a dark coat with ornate gold buttons and a thick, bright red scarf wrapped snugly around their neck, adding a pop of color and texture. The lighting is gentle and diffused, evoking a cozy, winter evening atmosphere, with a shallow depth of field that keeps the focus on the hands and cup while rendering the background into a dreamy bokeh. The overall style is intimate and inviting, with a soft, cinematic quality reminiscent of a holiday commercial or a heartwarming winter film.
